diagnostics.wing_alone_note: Post wing-fix (ce147d1, chords-centered LE sweep derived from params), the isolated wing's VLM AC lands at 24.0% MAC -- matching the textbook quarter-chord (~25%) almost exactly and confirming the fix landed correctly in VLM terms. Pre-fix this read 14.5% MAC (see task-6-report.md), a ~10-point forward shift caused by the wing's zero-LE-sweep-with-taper bug, not a reference/MAC-math bug (an untapered synthetic wing landed at ~24% even pre-fix).
diagnostics.hull_destabilization_note: Hull costs ~2.5 MAC points (7.97% no-hull -> 5.46% full model), consistent with the pre-fix isolation (also ~2.5 points) -- the hull's own contribution is unchanged by the wing fix, as expected.
diagnostics.alpha_sweep_note: Still a smooth, monotonic, ~0.9-point-per-degree trend -- the SAME slope as pre-fix (pre-fix: -4.32% to +2.84% over the same -2..6 alpha range, also ~0.9 pt/deg). The wing fix corrected the baseline (isolated-wing AC), not the tail-wake-proximity effect; that alpha-dependence is a real, separate, still-present physical effect (tail sensitivity to wake position vs. alpha), and it did NOT shrink -- it just no longer crosses zero within the tested alpha range post-fix, since the whole curve shifted up ~10 points.
diagnostics.verdict: SM=+5.46% MAC (full model) / +7.97% MAC (no-hull) at the rotation-AoA condition, post wing-fix. Matches the team lead's hand-checked +5..+8% MAC expectation (10-point recovery from the wing fix, minus real downwash + hull effects that are unchanged by the fix and still present). seaez/sizing.py's 11.5% SM oracle remains somewhat optimistic (no downwash term, and its AC=quarter-MAC assumption for the wing is a simplification even post-fix), but the design is now VLM-stable, not marginal/negative.
